# Every observation the mixed-era matrix owes, one per line, sorted.
#
# This file is the gate's expected set, and it is deliberately outside the run:
# deleting a case, building one out behind a tag, or renaming a test leaves the
# line here demanding an observation nothing produced, so the run goes red
# instead of quietly narrowing. Nothing regenerates it — a run that owes a line
# it does not find prints the exact text to add here.
#
#   case  <test>
#   case  <test> asserts <what it asserts>
#   claim <test> <era> <mechanism> evidenced
#   claim <test> <era> <mechanism> entailed-by <era> <mechanism>
#
# An evidenced claim is redeemed only against an artifact the case cannot
# fabricate: a process exit the OS reaped, bytes the relay copied, or the peer
# process's own verdict. An entailed claim carries no observation of its own and
# the manifest reports it ENTAILED, never PROVEN.
#
# Every case owes a claim or carries the "asserts" clause saying why it owes
# none. Other cases reprove most mechanisms, so deleting a case's claims leaves
# the coverage table whole and its body free to be emptied unnoticed; the clause
# makes that deletion an edit here, in front of a reviewer.

case TestFrozenFramePrefixes asserts the two eras carry well-formed frame prefixes that differ, which is what lets either answer the other with a typed mismatch
case TestFrozenPreambleCannotOpenAFrame asserts the frozen drain preamble opens a body larger than every frame cap in the fleet, so no era can mistake it for a frame
case TestMixedEra asserts nothing of its own: it builds the two era peers, freezes the coverage manifest, and runs the matrix below
case TestMixedEra/classify/cut asserts the cut peer's own unit tests pass, which is where that peer's failure classification is checked
case TestMixedEra/drain/preamble
case TestMixedEra/drain/preamble-absent-precut
case TestMixedEra/drain/preamble-emitted
case TestMixedEra/drain/sigterm-cut
case TestMixedEra/drain/sigterm-precut
case TestMixedEra/refuse/cut-client-precut-daemon
case TestMixedEra/refuse/precut-client-cut-daemon
case TestMixedEra/session/cut
case TestMixedEra/session/precut
case TestMixedEra/skew/build asserts the boundary release still gates a session on the exact build string, so a same-era client presenting a different build is refused — the one case that goes red if the pre-cut peer is really this tree
case TestMixedEra/wedge/18999
case TestPrecutBoundaryPredatesTheCut asserts the pinned boundary release is older than the release that demoted the build gate, so the pre-cut peer cannot be compiled against the rewrite
case TestProbeDeadlineNeedsBothTheStatusAndTheToken asserts the pre-cut start retries on the released peer's full probe signature and on nothing else
case TestRelayCapturesEveryConnectionSeparately asserts the relay keeps each connection's bytes separate, which every claim redeemed against the wire depends on
claim TestMixedEra/drain/preamble cut drain-preamble evidenced
claim TestMixedEra/drain/preamble-absent-precut precut drain-preamble evidenced
claim TestMixedEra/drain/preamble-absent-precut precut drain-preamble-trust-gate entailed-by precut drain-preamble
claim TestMixedEra/drain/preamble-emitted cut drain-preamble evidenced
claim TestMixedEra/drain/sigterm-cut cut drain-sigterm evidenced
claim TestMixedEra/drain/sigterm-precut precut drain-sigterm evidenced
claim TestMixedEra/refuse/cut-client-precut-daemon cut protocol-gate evidenced
claim TestMixedEra/refuse/cut-client-precut-daemon precut protocol-gate evidenced
claim TestMixedEra/refuse/precut-client-cut-daemon cut protocol-gate evidenced
claim TestMixedEra/refuse/precut-client-cut-daemon precut protocol-gate evidenced
claim TestMixedEra/session/cut cut frame-v1 evidenced
claim TestMixedEra/session/cut cut session evidenced
claim TestMixedEra/session/precut precut frame-v1 evidenced
claim TestMixedEra/session/precut precut session evidenced
claim TestMixedEra/wedge/18999 cut drain-preamble evidenced
claim TestMixedEra/wedge/18999 cut protocol-gate evidenced
claim TestMixedEra/wedge/18999 precut protocol-gate evidenced
